capabilities: Browse web pages and local HTML inside Obsidian tabs
Search selected text or pages with a default search engine
Copy links pointing to text highlights and video timestamps
Run Chrome extensions such as Tampermonkey and Dark Reader
Expose open tabs to AI agents through a local MCP server
extras: Chrome extensions and the MCP server are desktop-only and need an Obsidian installer of 1.12.4 or later (Electron 39+); extensions can't load while session isolation is on. MCP server is localhost-only, token-protected, and JavaScript execution is off by default.
intentEvidence: The core functionality of the plugin, rendering a web view, is greatly influenced by Ellpeck's Obsidian Custom Frames plugin
problem: Web links in Obsidian open in an external browser, taking users out of the vault while researching or reading.

relations.evidence: greatly influenced by Ellpeck's Obsidian Custom Frames plugin and this plugin wouldn't have been possible without it
This used to be the separate Chrome Extensions Bridge plugin.
while Obsidian's core Web Viewer plugin is enabled, extensions run in Web Viewer tabs
Use Quickadd to search selection in ChatGPT in Surfing

requires.name: AI agent client (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor)

summary: In-app web browser that opens web pages and local HTML in Obsidian tabs, with history, search, Chrome extensions and an MCP server for AI agents.
